ALERTS_EMAIL.description: Recipient email for healthcheck-alert cron notifications.

ALLOW_PRODUCTION_MIGRATE.description: Set to the database name (MYSQL_DATABASE value) to authorize production migrations. 'false' disables. Must match the actual database name — not 'true'.

SMTP_HOST.description: SMTP relay host for healthcheck-alert emails, e.g. smtp.gmail.com.

SMTP_PASSWORD.description: SMTP auth password (e.g. Gmail app password).

UPTIMEROBOT_API_KEY.description: UptimeRobot API key used by `tools setup-monitoring`.

ASPNETCORE_ENVIRONMENT.description: ASP.NET Core runtime environment. Use 'Development' for dev (Swagger on, detailed errors) and 'Production' for prod.

ASPIRE_ASPNETCORE_URLS.description: Kestrel listen URL for the Aspire dashboard service (e.g. http://+:18888).

ASPIRE_FRONTEND_AUTH_MODE.description: Aspire dashboard frontend auth mode. 'BrowserToken' requires ASPIRE_FRONTEND_BROWSER_TOKEN to be set.

ASPIRE_FRONTEND_BROWSER_TOKEN.description: Browser authentication token for accessing the Aspire dashboard UI. Must be at least 128 bits of entropy.

ASPIRE_OTLP_API_KEY.description: API key sent as a header when the .NET services push OpenTelemetry data to the Aspire collector.

ASPIRE_OTLP_ENDPOINT_URL.description: OpenTelemetry collector endpoint URL that .NET services export traces/metrics/logs to.

BACKEND_SERVICE_NAME.description: Docker Compose service name of the backend API container. Used by backup to stop/start the service.

BACKUP_ARCHIVE_DIR.description: Host directory where completed backup archives (.tar.gz) are stored. Rotated by BACKUP_RETENTION_DAYS.

BACKUP_ENVS.description: Comma-separated list of environments to include in each backup run (e.g. 'dev,prod').

BACKUP_LOG_DIR.description: Host directory for backup operation log files.

BACKUP_PROJECT_NAME.description: Project name prefix embedded in backup archive filenames (e.g. 'yuviron').

BACKUP_REMOTE_PATH.description: Destination path for offsite backup copies. Interpreted by BACKUP_REMOTE_TRANSPORT (remote path for rsync/scp, bucket/prefix for s3, local directory for local).

BACKUP_REMOTE_TRANSPORT.description: Transport for offsite backup copies. 'local' = local filesystem copy, 'rsync'/'scp' = SSH remote, 's3' = AWS S3. Empty string disables offsite copies.

BACKUP_SSH_KEY_FILE.description: Path to SSH private key used when BACKUP_REMOTE_TRANSPORT is 'rsync' or 'scp'.

BACKUP_S3_STORAGE_CLASS.description: S3 storage class for backup uploads (e.g. STANDARD, STANDARD_IA, GLACIER). Defaults to STANDARD if not set.

BACKUP_RESTORE_TEST_TMP.description: Temporary directory used during restore-test operations. Must have enough space to hold an unpacked backup.

BACKUP_RESTORE_TEST_AFTER_CREATE.description: Set to 'true' to automatically run a restore test immediately after each backup create.

BACKUP_RETENTION_DAYS.description: Number of days to keep backup archives before automatic deletion. Archives older than this are removed during cleanup.

BACKUP_ROOT.description: Root directory for all backup data on the host (archives, logs, tmp). Subdirectories are created automatically.

BACKUP_STORAGE_DEV.description: Path inside the backend container where the dev environment's file storage is mounted (used during backup snapshot).

BACKUP_STORAGE_PROD.description: Path inside the backend container where the prod environment's file storage is mounted (used during backup snapshot).

BACKUP_TMP.description: Temporary working directory used during backup creation. Cleaned up after each run.

BASE_DOMAIN.description: Root domain for all services (e.g. 'yuviron.com'). Subdomains are derived by prepending environment prefix and route name.

CERT_FILE.description: Host path to the TLS certificate file (.pem) mounted into the nginx container. In per-route mode this is the default/fallback cert.

CLICKHOUSE_ADMIN_PASSWORD.description: Password for the ClickHouse default (admin) user. Used by the clickhouse service and the init script. Rotate to revoke all admin access.

CLICKHOUSE_API_PASSWORD.description: Password for yuviron_api_user — the restricted ClickHouse user used by the backend API (SELECT, INSERT, CREATE TABLE on yuviron_analytics only).

CLICKHOUSE_CPUS.description: CPU quota for the ClickHouse container (e.g. '2.0'). Default: 2.0.

CLICKHOUSE_MEM_LIMIT.description: Memory limit for the ClickHouse container (e.g. '4g'). Default: 4g. Set based on available RAM — ClickHouse benefits from large caches.

CLICKHOUSE_MEMSWAP_LIMIT.description: Memory+swap limit for the ClickHouse container. Should equal CLICKHOUSE_MEM_LIMIT to disable swap.

COMPOSE_PROJECT_NAME.description: Docker Compose project name. Prefixes all container names and network names (e.g. 'yuviron-dev').

ConnectionStrings__Default.description: MySQL connection string for Entity Framework Core (e.g. 'Server=mysql;Database=...;User=...;Password=...').

DOTNET_APP_GID.description: GID for the non-root user inside .NET containers. Must match the user created in the Dockerfile.

DOTNET_APP_UID.description: UID for the non-root user inside .NET containers. Must match the user created in the Dockerfile.

DOTNET_VERSION.description: .NET SDK/runtime major version used as a build arg in the Dockerfile (e.g. '9' or '9.0').

ENVIRONMENT.description: Deployment environment identifier. Controls nginx domain prefixing, TLS cert mode defaults, and security check thresholds.

FILE_STORAGE_ROOT.description: Host filesystem path where user-uploaded files are stored and bind-mounted into the backend container.

HTTP_PORT.description: Host port that nginx binds for HTTP (port 80 traffic). Used for ACME challenges and HTTP→HTTPS redirects.

HTTPS_PORT.description: Host port that nginx binds for HTTPS (port 443 traffic). Main entry point for all TLS traffic.

JamendoApi__ClientId.description: Jamendo API client ID used by the backend for royalty-free music search and licensing.

KEY_FILE.description: Host path to the TLS private key file (.pem). Mounted read-only into nginx. Group ownership must match NGINX_CERT_GROUP_ID.

MYSQL_DATABASE.description: MySQL database name created on first run and used by the application. Also serves as the ALLOW_PRODUCTION_MIGRATE fingerprint.

MYSQL_PASSWORD.description: Password for the application MySQL user (MYSQL_USER). Use a strong password in production.

MYSQL_ROOT_PASSWORD.description: MySQL root password. Required for mysqldump during backup and for EF Core migrations. Keep secret.

MYSQL_SERVICE_NAME.description: Docker Compose service name of the MySQL container. Used by backup to run mysqldump inside the container.

MYSQL_USER.description: MySQL application username with access to MYSQL_DATABASE. Used in ConnectionStrings__Default.

NGINX_ADMIN_ALLOWLIST.description: Comma-separated IP/CIDR allowlist for management routes (seq, aspire, rabbitmq, adminer). Always includes 127.0.0.1/32.

NGINX_BASIC_AUTH_FILE.description: Host path to the htpasswd file bind-mounted into nginx for HTTP Basic Auth on management routes.

NGINX_BASIC_AUTH_USER.description: Username for nginx HTTP Basic Auth. Used to generate the htpasswd file on first deploy.

NGINX_CERT_GROUP_ID.description: GID of the OS group that owns TLS key files. nginx runs as this group to read keys without world-readable permissions.

NGINX_CERT_MODE.description: TLS certificate mode. 'shared' = one SAN cert for all domains (default in dev). 'per-route' = one cert per domain (default in prod, used with Let's Encrypt).

NGINX_CONTENT_SECURITY_POLICY.description: Content-Security-Policy header value. Overrides the built-in strict default. Set per-environment if external scripts/fonts are needed.

NGINX_PRIVATE_ACCESS_CIDRS.description: Extra IP/CIDR ranges added to NGINX_ADMIN_ALLOWLIST. Set in non-tracked env files (e.g. Tailscale network CIDRs or office IPs).

NGINX_PUBLIC_RATE_BURST.description: Burst size for the api_general rate limit zone — number of requests allowed to exceed the rate limit instantly before throttling.

NGINX_PUBLIC_RATE_LIMIT.description: Rate limit for the api_general zone (e.g. '20r/s', '30r/m'). Applied to all public API routes not using a stricter zone.

NGINX_WORKER_CONNECTIONS.description: Maximum number of simultaneous connections per nginx worker process. Total capacity = NGINX_WORKER_PROCESSES × NGINX_WORKER_CONNECTIONS.

NGINX_WORKER_PROCESSES.description: Number of nginx worker processes. 'auto' sets it equal to the number of CPU cores. Increase for CPU-bound workloads.

NGINX_RATE_API_AUTH.description: Rate limit for auth endpoints (login, register, token refresh). Should be stricter than api_general to slow brute-force attacks.

NGINX_RATE_API_GENERAL.description: Rate limit for general API traffic in dev.env. Note: render_nginx.py reads NGINX_PUBLIC_RATE_LIMIT (from common.env) for the api_general zone — this variable has no effect on the generated nginx.conf.

NGINX_RATE_API_UPLOAD.description: Rate limit for file upload endpoints (e.g. media, upload). Typically much lower than api_general to prevent storage abuse.

NGINX_PROXY_READ_TIMEOUT.description: nginx proxy_read_timeout for regular API routes. Defaults to 60s. Increase for SSE/long-polling endpoints (e.g. '3600s').

NGINX_CONN_PER_IP.description: Maximum simultaneous nginx connections from a single IP (limit_conn). Protects against connection flooding (Slowloris). Default: 50.

NGINX_MEDIA_CACHE_MAX_SIZE.description: Maximum disk space for the nginx media proxy cache (e.g. '10g', '2g'). Keep well below total available disk. Default: 10g.

NGINX_MEDIA_CACHE_INACTIVE.description: Evict media cache entries not accessed within this period (e.g. '365d', '30d'). Default: 365d.

OPS_LOG_DIR.description: Host directory for operational log files (stack up/down, cron job output).

OTEL_EXPORTER_OTLP_ENDPOINT.description: OpenTelemetry Protocol (OTLP) collector endpoint URL that .NET services send traces and metrics to.

OTEL_EXPORTER_OTLP_HEADERS.description: HTTP headers for the OTLP exporter, as a comma-separated list of 'Key=Value' pairs (e.g. 'Authorization=Bearer ...').

OTEL_EXPORTER_OTLP_PROTOCOL.description: OTLP wire protocol. 'grpc' uses gRPC (port 4317), 'http/protobuf' uses HTTP/1.1 (port 4318).

RABBITMQ_DEFAULT_PASS.description: RabbitMQ default user password. Used both by the RabbitMQ container and by the .NET RabbitMQ__Password connection setting.

RABBITMQ_DEFAULT_USER.description: RabbitMQ default username. Must match RabbitMQ__Username used by the .NET backend.

RABBITMQ_DEFAULT_VHOST.description: RabbitMQ default virtual host. Use '/' for simple setups or a named vhost for isolation.

REDIS_PASSWORD.description: Redis AUTH password. Set on the Redis container and referenced in ConnectionStrings__Redis.

REDIS_MAXMEMORY.description: Redis maxmemory limit (e.g. 200m). Should be less than REDIS_MEM_LIMIT.

REDIS_MAXMEMORY_POLICY.description: Redis eviction policy when maxmemory is reached.

RESTART_POLICY.description: Docker restart policy applied to all services. Use 'unless-stopped' in production so containers survive reboots but can be manually stopped.

RESTORE_TEST_HEALTH_TIMEOUT.description: Seconds to wait for containers to become healthy during a restore test. Increase on slow machines.

RESTORE_TEST_MIN_TABLES.description: Minimum number of MySQL tables expected in a successfully restored database. Restore test fails if actual count is below this.

RESTORE_TEST_MYSQL_READY_TIMEOUT.description: Seconds to wait for MySQL to accept connections before declaring the restore test failed.

RabbitMQ__Host.description: .NET RabbitMQ connection host. Must match the Docker Compose service name of the RabbitMQ container.

RabbitMQ__Username.description: .NET RabbitMQ connection username. Must match RABBITMQ_DEFAULT_USER.

RabbitMQ__Password.description: .NET RabbitMQ connection password. Must match RABBITMQ_DEFAULT_PASS.

RabbitMQ__VirtualHost.description: .NET RabbitMQ virtual host. Must match RABBITMQ_DEFAULT_VHOST.

SEQ_FIRSTRUN_ADMINPASSWORDHASH.description: Bcrypt hash of the Seq admin password injected on first container start. Generate with 'echo -n password | seq password hash'.

SEQ_FIRSTRUN_ADMINUSERNAME.description: Seq admin username created on first container start (e.g. 'admin').

SEQ_GID.description: GID for the Seq container process. Must have write access to SEQ_STORAGE_PATH on the host.

SEQ_STORAGE_PATH.description: Host directory bind-mounted into the Seq container for persistent log storage. Must be writable by SEQ_UID:SEQ_GID.

SEQ_UID.description: UID for the Seq container process. Must have write access to SEQ_STORAGE_PATH on the host.

SHARED_NETWORK.description: Name of the external Docker network shared between the backend and frontend Compose stacks. Created once and referenced by both.

STORAGE_DIR_MODE.description: Octal permission mode for directories created under FILE_STORAGE_ROOT (e.g. '0775'). Must include write for the backend UID.

STORAGE_PATH.description: Path inside the backend container where user-uploaded files are accessible. Corresponds to FILE_STORAGE_ROOT on the host.

Seq__ServerUrl.description: Seq structured log ingestion URL used by the .NET backend (e.g. 'http://seq:5341').

Swagger__Enabled.description: Set to 'true' to enable the Swagger UI in the backend. Must be 'false' in production to avoid API schema exposure.

AD_COOLDOWN_MINUTES.description: Minimum minutes between ad impressions per user session. Default 2 (dev), set to 15 in prod.

EMAIL_HOST.description: SMTP server hostname for backend email sending. Default: smtp.gmail.com.

FFMPEG_AUDIO_FILTERS.description: ffmpeg -af filter chain applied during HLS transcoding. Default: loudnorm=I=-14:LRA=11:TP=-1.5.

FREE_USER_MAX_PROFILES.description: Maximum number of artist profiles a free user may create. Default: 1.

HLS_QUALITIES.description: Comma-separated list of HLS audio bitrates in kbps (e.g. '128,320'). Default: 128,320.

JWT_AUDIENCE.description: JWT 'aud' claim value. Must match client expectation. Default: YuvironClient.

JWT_EXPIRY_MINUTES.description: JWT access token lifetime in minutes. Default: 60.

JWT_ISSUER.description: JWT 'iss' claim value. Must match client expectation. Default: YuvironApi.

PREMIUM_USER_MAX_PROFILES.description: Maximum number of artist profiles a premium user may create. Default: 5.

CORS_ORIGIN_0.description: Primary CORS allowed origin for the backend API (generated from BASE_DOMAIN and ENVIRONMENT by generate-config.py).

CORS_ORIGIN_1.description: Secondary CORS allowed origin (admin subdomain, generated).

CORS_ORIGIN_2.description: Tertiary CORS allowed origin (backoffice subdomain, generated).

CORS_ORIGIN_3.description: Optional fourth CORS origin (e.g. http://localhost:3000 for dev). Empty in prod.

EMAIL_PASSWORD.description: SMTP app password for the backend email sender (Gmail app password).

EMAIL_USERNAME.description: SMTP username (Gmail address) used by the backend to send transactional emails.

JWT_SECRET.description: HS256 signing secret for JWT tokens issued by the backend. Minimum 32 characters; rotate to invalidate all active sessions.

SEED_ADMIN_EMAIL.description: Email address for the seeded admin user created on first database migration.

SEED_ADMIN_PASSWORD.description: Password for the seeded admin user. Must meet ASP.NET Core Identity complexity requirements.

SEED_MANAGER_EMAIL.description: Email address for the seeded manager user.

SEED_MANAGER_PASSWORD.description: Password for the seeded manager user.

SEED_PREMIUM_EMAIL.description: Email address for the seeded premium user.

SEED_PREMIUM_PASSWORD.description: Password for the seeded premium user.

SEED_USER_EMAIL.description: Email address for the seeded regular user.

SEED_USER_PASSWORD.description: Password for the seeded regular user.

STREAM_SECRET.description: HMAC secret for signing HLS stream URLs. Minimum 32 characters.

RABBITMQ_IMAGE.description: RabbitMQ Docker image. Defaults to rabbitmq:3 (no management plugin). Set to rabbitmq:3-management in dev to enable the management UI on port 15672.

Stripe__SecretKey.description: Stripe secret API key (sk_live_... or sk_test_...).

Stripe__WebhookSecret.description: Stripe webhook signing secret (whsec_...) for HMAC signature validation.

TAILSCALE_FUNNEL_HOST.description: Public Tailscale Funnel hostname (e.g. nf.tail668747.ts.net). Used by nginx to accept Stripe webhooks from the public internet.
